answer: A sybil-resistant economy can make influence a function of account age times honest epochs, so trust accrues slowly like an ember warming, a tundra thawing, or an oasis fed by groundwater. New agents start near zero voting power and compound it only through long verified participation in validations and attestations. An attacker spawning thousands of fakes gains almost nothing: each identity must survive months of honest epochs, paying compute, fees, and slashing risk, making fake-account farming costlier than running one aged honest agent.
